top_choice_rationale: P001 carries two game-changer achievements with clean citations inside the three-laureate limit: base editing credited to Liu, with the evolved deaminase-nickase architecture named, and targeted protein degradation by induced proximity credited to Crews and Deshaies. Both reduce to a simple chemical idea with a quantifiable mechanism, independent replication and consequences not available before. The cost is that Komor and Gaudelli are left out, so P002, the one-part base-editing trio, is my fallback if the Liu-only credit is judged indefensible. P003 and P004 pair Liu with a mature but less compelling second part and rank below that. P000 is last because a mature, well-attributed prize is available.
